profile.headline: Senior SDET
profile.summary:
Seeking difficult problems to solve and optimizing them to the highest degree is what I seek.

So far my experience has brought me to the surprising amount of issues companies have regarding quality testing and streamlining their processes. In solving this, I've been set on this on-going route of architecting, designing, and developing solutions for companies to enhance the effectiveness, reliability, communication, and speed of their testing and overall release cycles. Ideally living in a state where everything is 100% automated!

This is where my story began. But not how it has ended. I'm still diving into APIs and developing on platforms like iOS. And every new job has been a new experience and opportunity for these skillsets to grow. If you are looking for a passionate individual who wants to streamline or optimize your systems, just give me a shout!

positions.title: Senior iOS Automation Engineer
positions.description: Skills: GitHub · Cypress · Xcode · Qase · REST APIs · CircleCI · TestRail · Fastlane

positions.title: Software Mobile Quality Engineer @ PayPal
positions.description:
Worked as the Primary Automation Developer for the Native Identity Team and Managed team’s App Release Cycle

Native Identity Automation Consisted of:
     - Native Authentication Flows
     - Login Feature Flows
     - User Confirmation/Registration
     - And all the edge cases that come with it

Wrote Automation Flows for Mobile using Cucumber and Appium
     - Created Automation Coverage for over 70% of all Identity/Authentication Test Cases
     - Wrote Test Cases to be Ran Daily to check against new code changes and have daily metrics
     - Utilized Appium in Ruby
     - Wrote retry logic to combat against race conditions

Created new Automation Nodes/Environments for CI
     - Created a Node that Jenkins CI triggers to run and report Mobile Automation

Managed Team’s Regression Cycle for Releases
     - Reported to Release Team regarding the team’s feature and bug status
     - Ran Automated and Manual Regression on Release Builds
     - Triaged and Managed Team’s Bug based on priority
     - Handled initiatives for testing against new OS and major app changes
     - Handled requests from other teams

General Support:
     - Managed Stage Environments for QA and Experiment Purposes
     - Triaged and Debugged Bugs
     - Fixed Android Bugs
positions.insights: Skills: GitHub · Espresso · Xcode · REST APIs

positions.title: Software Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Created and Managed our Continuous Integration System (using Jenkins):
- Implemented with the use of WebHooks
- Implemented with Hockeyapp
- Can create and manage multiple builds of different projects
- Added the use of Crash Reports to automatically notify any issues to selected team members

Wrote and Architected a series of Automation Tests (using Espresso):
- Performs UI Testing on Android Applications
- Architected and Manage a Complete Full Regression Test
- Architected and Manage a Sanity Test
- Architected and Manage a Complete Functional Test
- Wrote Stress Tests
